newsitem.title: UK: Blair, Jospin to meet for private lunch on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Blair, Jospin to meet for private lunch on Friday.

text.p: British Prime Minister Tony Blair will meet his French counterpart, Lionel Jospin, socially on Friday while on holiday in southwestern France, British officials said on Monday.
Blair, his wife Cherie and their three children are staying in the small village of St Martin d'Oydes in a house owned by a London lawyer.
The village is about 30 km (20 miles) from Cintegabelle, the main city in the parliamentary district which Jospin represents in parliament.
One Blair aide said Jospin had accepted an invitation to "a private lunch chez the prime minister (Blair)".
Blair began his summer break in Tuscany, meeting Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi in Bologna on August 2.
